scoring_justification: All required quantities can be recomputed from the agent's raw artifacts without trusting self-reported metrics: phonon quantities are extracted from CSV, g+ peak positions are found by histogram analysis, and impurity mode frequencies are read directly from JSON.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for phonon frequencies/elastic constants, g+ peak positions, and impurity mode frequencies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tableau 1 (experimental column), Tableau 4 (g+ maxima from model), and text (B/In local mode 522.8 cm⁻¹, gap mode ~257 cm⁻¹ from paper’s discussion)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper; the reference solve.sh produces these exact values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s published numbers; the checker compares the agent’s computed results to these, not to arbitrary synthetic targets.

units.computed_value: 10^11 dyn/cm^2 for elastic constants; 10^12 Hz for frequencies

outputs.description: Table of computed elastic constants and phonon frequencies at high-symmetry points. Rows with quantity='C11','C12','C44' give elastic constants; rows with ω_LO(Γ), ω_TO(Γ), ω_LA(X), ω_LO(X), ω_TA(X), ω_TO(X), ω_LO(L), ω_LA(L), ω_TA(L), ω_TO(L) give phonon frequencies.
Histogram of the two-phonon summation density of states g+(ω). Arrays are of equal length and cover 0–700 cm-1.
Local mode and gap mode frequencies for a B impurity on the In site, computed with t = -0.25.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts derive from the published RIM 11 parameter set; the fitting procedure is not required. The checker compares computed values to paper-reported experimental references within suitable tolerances.
